name: folder-templates
description: Automatically apply templates to Obsidian notes based on their paths

scripts.format: prettier --write src test README.md package.json styles.css esbuild.config.mjs manifest.json versions.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test README.md package.json styles.css esbuild.config.mjs manifest.json versions.json .prettierrc.json
